title: Four straight sides, four angles
description: Shows what makes a figure a quadrilateral: a closed shape of exactly four straight sides with one angle at each corner.

title: Both strips must be 8 cm
description: Shows rectangle ABCD whose two diagonals, the carpenter's two strips, are both 8 cm long.

title: The diagonals of a rectangle meet at their middles
description: Shows rectangle ABCD whose 8 cm diagonals cross at O, cutting each other into four 4 cm halves.

title: Diagonals at 60° still make right angles
description: Shows equal diagonals bisecting each other at 60°: the corner at A is made of 60° and 30°, which is 90°.

title: Any crossing angle still gives right angles
description: Shows that equal diagonals bisecting each other at 40° still make every corner 70° + 20° = 90°.

title: Two equal sticks and a thread
description: Shows two equal sticks crossed at their midpoints, with a thread round the four ends making a rectangle with right angle corners.

title: Four right angles force equal opposite sides
description: Shows quadrilateral ABCD with four right angles split by diagonal BD into two congruent triangles, so its opposite sides are equal.

title: Two right angles make the sides parallel
description: Shows rectangle ABCD with side AD as a transversal: ∠A + ∠D = 90° + 90° = 180°, so AB is parallel to DC.

title: A rectangle's diagonals make isosceles triangles
description: Shows rectangle ABCD whose diagonals meet at O, with ∠CAB = 30° giving the equal angle ∠ABD = 30° and 120° at O.

title: Squares sit inside rectangles
description: Shows that a 4 cm by 4 cm square belongs inside the set of rectangles, next to a 5 cm by 2 cm rectangle that is not a square.

title: The diagonals of a square cross at right angles
description: Shows square ABCD built on a diagonal of 8 cm: equal diagonals, cut in half at O, crossing at 90°.

title: A diagonal splits each corner into 45° and 45°
description: Shows square ABCD with diagonal AC cutting the right angles at A and C into two 45° parts each.

title: Perpendicular diameters make a square
description: Shows that two perpendicular diameters of a circle join up into a square.

topic_name: The Angle Sum of a Quadrilateral
title: A diagonal makes two triangles, 360° in all
description: Shows quadrilateral SOME split by diagonal SM into two triangles, with angles 75°, 95°, 110° and 80° adding up to 360°.

topic_name: The Angle Sum of a Quadrilateral
title: Three right angles leave 90° for the fourth
description: Shows that a quadrilateral with three right angles must have a fourth angle of 360° − 270° = 90°.

topic_name: The Angle Sum of a Quadrilateral
title: A caved in quadrilateral still makes 360°
description: Shows a quadrilateral with one corner that caves in, split by its inside diagonal into two triangles, with angles 30°, 40°, 50° and 240° adding up to 360°.

title: Parallel opposite sides, no right angle
description: Shows parallelogram ABCD with AB = 4 cm, AD = 5 cm and a 30° angle: opposite sides parallel, yet not a rectangle.

title: Next-door angles add to 180°
description: Shows parallelogram ABCD with angles 30°, 150°, 30° and 150°: next-door angles add to 180° and opposite angles are equal.

title: Opposite sides of a parallelogram are equal
description: Shows parallelogram ABCD cut by diagonal BD into two congruent triangles, so CB = 5 cm and CD = 4 cm.

title: Equal opposite sides mean parallel sides
description: Shows a quadrilateral whose opposite sides are equal, 6 cm and 4 cm, which is a parallelogram with both pairs of opposite sides parallel.

title: The diagonals of a parallelogram bisect each other
description: Shows parallelogram EASY whose diagonals AY = 10 cm and ES = 6 cm cross at O, cutting each other into 5 cm and 3 cm halves.

title: Diagonals 7 cm and 5 cm at 140°
description: Shows the parallelogram built from diagonals of 7 cm and 5 cm that bisect each other at 140°.

title: Four equal sides without a right angle
description: Shows rhombus ABCD with all sides 5 cm and ∠A = 50°, made by two compass arcs crossing at C.

title: A rhombus with a 50° angle
description: Shows rhombus ABCD with ∠A = 50° whose diagonal BD makes four equal 65° angles, so the angles are 50°, 130°, 50° and 130°.

title: The diagonals of a rhombus cross at right angles
description: Shows rhombus GAME whose diagonals GM = 8 cm and EA = 6 cm bisect each other at O at 90°.

title: A rhombus from diagonals 4 cm and 5 cm
description: Shows the rhombus built from diagonals of 5 cm and 4 cm that bisect each other at right angles.

title: Stretch one band: square to rhombus
description: Before and after: two 4 cm bands crossing at right angles at their midpoints make a square; stretching one band to 8 cm makes a rhombus.

title: Two 8, 8, 6 triangles make a rhombus
description: Shows two copies of the triangle with sides 8 cm, 8 cm and 6 cm joined along the 6 cm side, giving four outer sides of 8 cm: a rhombus.

title: Two triangles: turned or flipped
description: Before and after: two copies of a 6 cm, 9 cm, 12 cm triangle joined along the 12 cm side, turned half round to make a parallelogram, or flipped over to make a kite.

title: Two equilateral triangles make a rhombus
description: Shows two equilateral triangles of side 4 cm joined into a rhombus whose diagonals cross at right angles, with angles 60° and 120°.

title: One diagonal of a kite cuts the other in half at 90°
description: Shows kite ABCD with AB = BC and CD = DA, whose diagonal BD cuts AC in half at right angles at O.

title: A kite from diagonals 6 cm and 8 cm
description: Shows the kite built from diagonals AC = 6 cm and BD = 8 cm, where BD cuts AC in half at right angles but O is not the middle of BD.

title: Angles along each slanted side add to 180°
description: Shows trapezium PQRS with PQ parallel to SR: ∠P = 70° and ∠S = 110° along one slanted side, ∠Q = 55° and ∠R = 125° along the other.

title: Equal slanting sides give equal base angles
description: Shows isosceles trapezium UVWX with UX = VW, ∠U = ∠V = 65° and ∠W = ∠X = 115°, with the two dropped perpendiculars.

title: Equal angles in an isosceles trapezium
description: Shows an isosceles trapezium with a 100° angle: both top angles are 100° and both bottom angles are 80°.

title: A square has five family names
description: Shows one square surrounded by the five family names it belongs to.

title: Diagonals bisecting at 90° make a rhombus
description: Shows quadrilateral ABCD whose diagonals bisect each other at right angles at O, so the four triangles are congruent and all four sides are equal.

title: The quadrilateral family rings
description: Shows the nested family rings: rectangles and rhombuses overlap in squares inside parallelograms, and kites meet parallelograms exactly in the rhombuses.

title: Three things we found
description: A clean summary of the chapter in three items: equal bisecting diagonals make a rectangle, the families nest, and every quadrilateral's angles add up to 360°.

title: Fold, crease, unfold: a rhombus
description: Shows an unfolded sheet with its two fold lines crossing at the centre and the copied crease making a rhombus whose diagonals lie along the folds.
